department: Wadsworth Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Fall application deadline is April 1, 2027 on the graduate school's program page.

gre_general.value: GRE is required for applicants without an ABET-accredited bachelor's or master's; all applicants are encouraged to submit it for funding.
gre_general.quote: Applicants who do not have an ABET-accredited B.S. degree or M.S. degree are required to submit GRE scores | All applicants are encouraged to submit GRE scores for fellowship and funding options

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty member must agree to advise before admission.

funding.value: The catalog and program page give no funding guarantee.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an engineering B.S. or M.S. from an ABET or internationally recognized program.
entry_route.quote: A B.S. and/or M.S. degree in engineering from an institution which has an ABET accredited program in that discipline

notes: Minimum GPA of 3.0 in previous college work. Three reference letters, a statement of purpose.
name: Civil Engineering, PhD
